judged_text: The Disqus import was rewired onto TopicEmbed.import_remote, silently dropping the `--category` option (removed from method_option), the `created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at])` pass-through, and its previous zero-network-dependency behavior. Scripted imports that pass `-c` break; imported topics lose their original Disqus dates (created_at becomes import time); and each thread now requires a live HTTP fetch with no error handling, so one dead/404 link aborts the whole bulk import mid-run with no resume or report.

adjudication.rationale: In `lib/tasks/disqus.thor`, the `method_option :category, aliases: '-c'` is removed and the logic that mapped it to `category_id` is deleted, so scripted imports using `-c` will no longer work. The previous `PostCreator.new(..., created_at: Date.parse(t[:created_at]), category: category_id)` is replaced with `TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, which does not pass `created_at` (and `TopicEmbed.import_remote`/`.import` don’t accept it), so imported topics will use import-time timestamps. Additionally, `import_remote` does `open(url).read` with no rescue/error handling, so a 404/network failure can raise and abort the Thor task mid-run.
